mootSayLines.text: Word reaches you, days late: Esteban stands accused over what happened to Katarina. There's going to be a moot. People are choosing sides.
Yuki has been talking at the fires. Enough voices — tonight they call a moot. Esteban answers for what happened to Katarina.
🔴 LIVE! THE MOOT! The fire's built HIGH and the whole GALAXY is watching!
Yuki calls the moot. The fire gets built up — word travels fast, and almost everyone comes.
The moot turns to you. Your vote matters here — and everyone will remember it.
The moot doesn't wait forever. Two days of silence from the fire's edge — the count is taken without you.
Word reaches you, days late: Ezra stands accused over what happened to Pedro. There's going to be a moot. People are choosing sides.
They're named, every one: Theo Murphy, Omar Weiss, Sam Calhoun. Your move — ask them questions (up to three), call a MOOT on it, or turn them away at the edge of the firelight.
Pedro has been talking at the fires. Enough voices — tonight they call a moot. Ezra answers for what happened to Pedro.
🔴 LIVE! THE MOOT! The fire's built HIGH and the whole GALAXY is watching!
Pedro calls the moot. The fire gets built up — word travels fast, and almost everyone comes.
The moot turns to you. Your vote matters here — and everyone will remember it.
The moot doesn't wait forever. Two days of silence from the fire's edge — the count is taken without you.
They waited three days at the edge of your fire. Nobody called the moot. Theo nods — not angry, just done — and they walk.
◈ The Records: You won The Moot under the cameras. The village's glory, public and loud.
